resources.string: Checking for updates…
One moment, comparing your version with the latest one.
You have the latest version
There\'s nothing to update right now.
Downloading the new version…
When it\'s done it installs by itself: the app closes for a moment, then opens again. Keep the TV on.
%1$s of %2$s MB
%1$s MB
Installing the update…
The app will close for a moment, then open again by itself. Keep the TV on.
Allow the installation
A window from the TV\'s system appeared: allow the installation in it. The app will close for a moment, then open again.
The update isn\'t finished
The system window was closed before you answered. Press “Try again” to update now.
Update installed
Open Shasha again to run the new version.
The update was cancelled
Nothing changed in Shasha. Press “Try again” whenever you want to update.
Installing isn\'t allowed yet
Shasha hasn\'t been given permission to install updates. Run the installer from the installer kit on the computer again (it grants this permission), then press “Try again”.
Updates aren\'t available in this copy
This copy of Shasha can\'t check for updates. Install the latest copy with the installer kit on the computer, and from then on it updates with one press.
Installed
Latest
Check again
Couldn\'t connect to the internet
Make sure the TV is connected to the internet, then press “Try again”.
Couldn\'t check for updates
This copy can no longer read updates. Install the latest copy of Shasha with the installer kit on the computer, and from then on it updates with one press.
The service is busy right now
Updates couldn\'t be checked just now. Wait a little, then press “Try again”.
No published update found
No version has been published yet, or it couldn\'t be reached. Try again later.
The new version isn\'t finished yet
The latest version is still being prepared. Try again in a little while.
The version information isn\'t understood
We received information about the latest version that we couldn\'t understand. Try again later.
An unexpected answer
We got an answer we couldn\'t understand. Press “Try again” in a little while.
The download stopped
The file couldn\'t be downloaded in full. Press “Try again”.
The downloaded file isn\'t valid
The system couldn\'t read the file, so nothing was installed. Press “Try again”.
The file isn\'t for Shasha
The downloaded file is for another app, so it wasn\'t installed.
There\'s nothing newer
The downloaded file isn\'t newer than your current version, so it wasn\'t installed.
The update was refused to protect you
The downloaded file isn\'t signed with Shasha\'s original signature, so it wasn\'t installed.
The installation didn\'t finish
The TV\'s system refused the installation. Press “Try again”; if it keeps happening, run the installer from the installer kit on the computer.
Updates are in the adult profile
Checking for and installing updates is done from the adult profile\'s settings. Ask a parent.
